item.description: Melior Capital Ltd, the operator of Cyprus' no.1 recruitment platform Ergodotisi, announces that an investment vehicle led by Vladimir Pravdivy and Petras Vaicius has acquired a controlling stake in the company.

item.title: Digital Tree e-Publishers Lists €15 Million Corporate Bond in Vienna | Digital Tree
item.description: Nicosia, Cyprus – October 2025 — Digital Tree e-Publishers Ltd (“DTP”), one of Cyprus’s leading digital media and marketing groups, is pleased to announce the successful listing of its €15,000,000 8.5% Senior Bonds due 25 August 2031 (ISIN: CH1478539088, Bloomberg Ticker: DIGTRE) on the Vienna MTF, operated by the Vienna Stock Exchange (Wiener Börse).

item.title: Digital Tree Acquires the Premium Domain INK.com, Redefining the Future of Media in Cyprus | Digital Tree
item.description: Nicosia, Cyprus – November 13, 2025 – Digital Tree, a leading digital media and technology group in Cyprus, announces the acquisition of the iconic domain INK.COM, marking one of the most strategic moves in the Cypriot media landscape and solidifying its position as a key shaper of the future of digital journalism in Cyprus and beyond.

item.title: Evresis Undertakes the New Call Center of the Department of Road Transport | Digital Tree
item.description: Evresis, one of the newest companies to fully join the Digital Tree Group, has signed a new agreement with the Department of Road Transport for the creation and operation of a modern call center that will significantly enhance citizen services. The agreement was signed on Monday, November 24th, in the presence of the Minister of Transport, Communications and Works, Alexis Vafeades, marking the beginning of a meaningful upgrade in an area that has faced long-standing challenges.

item.title: Cyta's “Diver” Film Wins a Silver in Production, a Gold, and a Grand Ermis in Sound | Digital Tree
item.description: The success of every major production begins long before the cameras start rolling. It begins with a collaboration built on trust and a shared vision. For the “DIVER” campaign, Cyta and Gnomi Integrated Communications proved that when a client and an advertising agency truly embrace creativity, the result can be historic, especially when supported by a team like Cube Productions that can turn a “dream into reality.”

item.title: Digital Tree Acquires Focusnet to Expand Its End-to-End Digital Services Offering | Digital Tree
item.description: Premium hosting, expertly managedDigital Tree has announced the full acquisition of Focusnet, a Cyprus-based provider of domain hosting and email hosting services. The acquisition, completed in late 2025, marks a strategic step in Digital Tree’s mission to offer comprehensive, end-to-end digital solutions for businesses.
